headlines.title: Everything you need for election night: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to a special Election Day edition of the From the Politics Desk newsletter, where we’re putting all the links and information you’ll need when the vote tallies start rolling in tonight in one place.

headlines.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as Republican leader after GOP losses
headlines.description: A day after Democrats won the House majority, Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., told his staff in a phone call this morning he will not not stay on as Republican leader in the new Congress, according to four sources on the call.

headlines.title: Decision 2026: Democrats Win Control of House and Senate
headlines.description: Voters from coast-to-coast deliver a once-in-a-generation realignment in the nation’s capital with Democrats seizing overwhelming control of Congress in a shocking loss for President Donald Trump and the GOP. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Nikki Haley to Republicans: ‘This is Not the Time to Whine’
headlines.description: Former Republican governor of South Carolina and NBC News political contributor Nikki Haley joins TODAY with a message to Republicans and Democrats following the midterm elections results and the seismic shift in power. “To my fellow Republicans, this is not the time to whine, complain or point fingers…The bottom line is Republicans didn’t listen to the American people, they listened to Washington. D.C.,” adding, “For our Democrats, you can celebrate but be careful what you wish for. Y

headlines.title: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries Talks Midterm Results
headlines.description: Democratic House Leader Hakeem Jeffries joins TODAY to talk about the stunning results of the 2026 midterm elections, saying “It’s a decisive rebuke of MAGA extremism.” He also discusses how the affordability crisis will be top priority, weighs in on how they’ll address alleged corruption, and more.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.
